scenario_text: Two mutually inhibitory neural pools form a competition circuit that alternates dominance, as in perceptual rivalry. Each pool suppresses the other, and slow adaptation of the winning pool eventually lets the loser take over, producing alternating activity. We follow both pool activities plus an adaptation variable from initial conditions. The aim is to recover the activity rate law of one pool.
